'''Rekkiad''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the remote [[Rekkiad system/Legends|Rekkiad system]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. A desolate world covered in [[Water/Legends|ice]] and snow, it was where the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]] hid [[Mandalore's Mask]] following the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

==History==
In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] between the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Dramath the Second]] came to Rekkiad. He, accompanied by some of his most devoted followers, fled his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Nathema|Medriaas]] when his half-[[Brother/Legends|brother]] [[Tenebrae]] slew their [[Dramath|father]] and launched his [[Medriaas revolution|campaign]] to conquer their world. When he [[Death/Legends|died]], his servants built his [[Dramath the Second's tomb|tomb]] which was later [[Search for Dramath the Second's remains|found and broken into]] by an [[Unidentified Sith emissary|emissary]] of Vitiate's who took his [[Skeleton/Legends|remains]] for his master.<ref name="Revan" />

The tomb was subsequently discovered again by Revan and Malak, who hid the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore's]] mask in [[Dramath the Second's sarcophagus|Dramath's sarcophagus]]. Later, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] deduced the location of the mask and several clans came to Rekkiad to [[Search for Mandalore's Mask|look for it]]. Among the Mandalorians were [[Canderous Ordo]], who was accompanied by Revan who was looking for answers as to what had happened to him and Malak to corrupt them and turn them into minions of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Revan and Canderous found Dramath's tomb with the Mandalore's Mask inside as well as a [[Dramath the Second's datacron|datacron]] with information about Dramath and his history.<ref name="Revan" />
